name: kompass-gateway
description: Classifier-routed free-model gateway for Claude Code — one Cloudflare Worker routes your coding sessions across free model providers by task complexity

KOMPASS_BEARER.description: A password for **your own gateway** — you will paste this into the chat app to sign in. Generate one at [kompass-iota.vercel.app#quickstart](https://kompass-iota.vercel.app#quickstart), or run `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep a copy: changing it later means signing in again everywhere.

KOMPASS_MASTER_KEY.description: Encrypts any AI provider keys you add later (AES-GCM, stored in your own KV namespace). Generate a second, **different** value the same way. You do not need this to start — the gateway answers using Cloudflare Workers AI on your own account with no provider signup at all. Losing it only means re-entering provider keys.

CONFIG.description: KV namespace holding your lane/model configuration. A sensible default is compiled into the Worker, so this can stay empty until you want to customise routing.

KOMPASS_STATE.description: Durable Object for the shared quota ledger, model health cooldowns and session stickiness — what keeps one machine from spending another machine’s free-tier quota.

AI.description: Cloudflare Workers AI. This is why a fresh install works with no AI provider signup: the binding authenticates as your own account, so there is no API key to obtain.
